description.value: Batch 44 is a family-owned craft brewery and full-service kitchen on Sechelt's waterfront, pouring award-winning house beers alongside cocktails, BC wines, and cider. A dog-friendly patio, long communal tables, and a broad menu from poutine to fresh tuna poke make it an inviting gathering spot on the Sunshine Coast. Regular community events — trivia nights, karaoke, and Rock and Roll Bingo — give it a lively local character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and corroborates OSM data. The site prominently features an 'ORDER TAKEOUT' button confirming takeout service, and the menu lists multiple GF-tagged items and vegetarian options (tofu, veggie spring rolls, pesto flatbreads). A minor address discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Wharf Road' while the website consistently uses 'Wharf Ave'. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi details appear in the website text; OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by the website so it is left null.
concerns: Street name discrepancy: OSM records 'Wharf Road' but the business website consistently uses 'Wharf Ave' (5559 Wharf Ave). Address field updated to match website; OSM should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established waterfront brewery and kitchen in Sechelt with takeout, a dog-friendly patio, and a broad menu including GF options — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple GF-tagged items (chicken wings, Greek salad, spring garden salad, tuna poke with GF option) and vegetarian options including veggie spring rolls, mushroom flatbread, and crispy tofu as an add-on
